title: Original-complex restriction and tensor comparison on small algebraic-space models
statement:
Fix a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme] and algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Use their recorded small ringed module models, actual restriction equivalences, unbounded derived categories $D_X=X.\operatorname{DerivedModules}$, derived direct image and K-flat tensor models $T_X=X.\operatorname{derivedDualityModel}.\operatorname{closed}.\operatorname{tensor}$ [def-sfb-space-derived-module-calculus], with arbitrary common localization morphism universe $w$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the ordinary module tensor pullback [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], its already recorded total left derived functor $Lf^*$ and universal comparison $\lambda_f$ [def-sfb-space-derived-tensor-pullback] [def-sfb-space-derived-pullback]. Composition is the existing chart-scalar-normalized composition [def-sfb-space-module-tensor-composition], and the ordinary and derived adjunctions are those already recorded in [def-sfb-space-affine-hom-comparison]. These functors and comparisons are not redefined.

Actual restriction is additive. Define $r_X$ on original-site cochain complexes by applying $X.\operatorname{smallModuleRestriction}$ in every degree. Ordinary tensor pullback is additive. For $f:X\to Y$, define $r_Xf^*$ on cochain complexes by ordinary termwise tensor pullback followed by $r_X$. Define the natural isomorphism $\theta_f:f^*_{\rm sm}r_Y\cong r_Xf^*$ from the unit of the fixed module equivalence. For an original-site complex $G$ on $Y$, define the canonical coefficient map $Lf^*Q_Y(r_YG)\to Q_X(r_Xf^*G)$ as $\lambda_f(r_YG)$ followed by localization of the termwise comparison $\theta_f$.

Retain the recorded ordinary scalar/unit and signed total-complex tensor normalization [def-sfb-space-pullback-tensor-comparison]. Transport its ordinary total comparison to the actual total complexes used by the recorded tensor models: it is the unique natural isomorphism whose component on every summand $i+j=n$ sends $b\otimes(m\otimes n)$ to $(b\otimes m)\otimes(1\otimes n)$, using the recorded actual local tensor sections and coproduct inclusions. Define $Lf^*T_Y\cong T_X(Lf^*\times Lf^*)$ on just the two participating localizations to be the unique natural isomorphism satisfying the square with the shared counits $\lambda_f$, this transported total comparison, and the recorded K-flat tensor representative isomorphisms on every pair of flat-term K-flat complexes. The pulled-back representatives are flat-term K-flat. All comparisons are uniquely fixed by these representative equations; none is chosen from a bare existence of an isomorphism. The recorded ordinary and derived Q33 comparisons remain available unchanged, and no second tensor or derived pullback functor is defined.
